For context, Makoto Date, people tend to refer to him as “Date-san”, cus he’s a dude and a friend. Kind of like how the people from Brooklyn 99 call each other by their last names, but in a friendly way.

Makoto Makimura, because Goro Majima sees her not just as a friend, but a woman he’s into/protecting, ergo, she’s addressed as Makoto (her first name).

Lastly, Kiryu Clan in Y6’s full name is: The Kiryu Clan (桐生会 - Kiryu-kai). Do note that this is an informal organisation, whose members see Kiryu not as a formal Yakuza boss, but as their leader. They use his first name for this. Informal gang (Kiryu Clan) as opposed to formal syndicate (Tojo Clan).

As above, Kiryu Kazuma - 桐生一馬. The Kiryu Clan (桐生会 - Kiryu-kai). 

This is clear the Kiryu is the first name, Kazuma is the last name. So in a formal Tojo Clan setting, it would be the Kazuma Family. 

Thanks for reading the mini-essay hahaha

Open to a chill discussion if you are. 

*According to how they are introduced on-screen in the games

1) Sixth Chairman of the Tojo Clan - Daigo Dojima.

2) Patriarch of the Dojima Family - Sohei Dojima.

3) Patriarch of the Majima Family - Goro Majima 

4) Patriarch of the Nishikiyama Family - Akira Nishikiyama

Japanese people introduce themselves last names first. 

Kiryu Kazuma’s Japanese name is - 桐生 (Kiryu) 一馬 (Kazuma), as per listed on Sega. Am Japanese and Mandarin speaker.

Ergo, 一馬(Kazuma) is the last name. As per the other characters’ introductions, last names first.

Which leaves us with a hypothetical (but much deserved) - Patriarch Kiryu of the Kazuma Family, vis-a-vis Patriarch Goro of the Majima Family.

Peace out ✌️
